speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help understand the cause of your bleeding, can you tell me how long you've been experiencing the nosebleeds and petechiae, and have you noticed any unusual bruising or joint pain?

text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has the child had any recent fevers, weight loss, or bone pain? I also need to know if there is a family history of bleeding disorders.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Frequent epistaxis. I also have Mucous membrane bleeding, Diffuse petechiae on distal extremities.

text: Given the normal platelet count and coagulation profile, I suspect a qualitative platelet defect. Does the child have a history of easy bruising since infancy, and is there a family history of similar bleeding issues?
